'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Mike Gemme DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Gemme]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Gemme]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me & Take Your Father's Place]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
